title.zh: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
title.en: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog

current_state.zh: HTX settled with the UK's FCA in the High Court, agreeing to stop soliciting UK consumers and exiting the market, with UK users given 48 hours to withdraw assets — the regulator's first case against a crypto firm under financial promotion rules.
current_state.en: HTX settled with the UK's FCA in the High Court, agreeing to stop soliciting UK consumers and exiting the market, with UK users given 48 hours to withdraw assets — the regulator's first case against a crypto firm under financial promotion rules.
